{{RV|type=command

|game1= arma3
|version1= 2.18

|gr1= Object Manipulation

|descr= Returns current settings for the remains collector and the list of monitored units if any.

|s1= [[diag_remainsCollector]] option

|p1= option: [[Number]] - can be one of:
* -1: {{GVI|arma3|2.20}} log remains collector entities into a file in the [[arma.RPT|RPT]] directory - see also the {{Link|Arma 3: Cheats#REMAINS|REMAINS}} cheat and the {{hl|{{Link|Multiplayer Server Commands#Performance Profiling|#logremains}}}} {{Link|Multiplayer Server Commands|server command}}.{{Feature|important|Only available in {{Link|Arma 3: Diagnostics Exe|Diagnostic}}/{{Link|Performance Profiling|Profiling}} branch.}}
* 0: corpses - returns [disposalPeriod, managerMode, removeLimit, removeMinTime, removeMaxTime, minPlayerDistance, unit1, unit2...]
* 1: wrecks - returns [disposalPeriod, managerMode, removeLimit, removeMinTime, removeMaxTime, minPlayerDistance, unit1, unit2...]
* 2: weaponholders - returns [disposalPeriod, managerMode, removeLimit, removeMinTime, removeMaxTime, minPlayerDistance, unit1, unit2...]
* 3: {{GVI|arma3|2.20}} overrideTimes - returns [overrideTimeCorpses, overrideTimeWrecks, overrideTimeWeaponholders]

|r1= [[Array]] with [disposalPeriod, managerMode, removeLimit, removeMinTime, removeMaxTime, minPlayerDistance, unit1, unit2...] or [overrideTimeCorpses, overrideTimeWrecks, overrideTimeWeaponholders]

|x1= <sqf>hintSilent str diag_remainsCollector 0;</sqf>

|seealso= [[addToRemainsCollector]] [[removeFromRemainsCollector]] [[isInRemainsCollector]]
}}
